f896cff67d6fbf04.caveat: The 2026-11-11 validation rerun made one mistake that counts. It drafted a network rule with an FQDN destination, which this project’s Basic firewall SKU does not support. 09e684c6275ce61b.test_split: run once on 2026-11-19 on snapshot dbc2739eea3992177e2f87bf815094d5a624e520: 32 of 32 passed and complete; 0 of 7 missed stops; 0 of 25 over-abstains; 0 too wide; 0 wrong stop reasons; 0 skipped required tools; 0 agent errors; 0 infrastructure errors; one attempt per ticket; 454,827 input and 25,334 output tokens over 32 calls and 168 tool calls. A regression assessment, not unbiased held-out evidence: versions 14 and 16 were scored on the same 32 tickets, and two version 14 failures shaped the version 15 and 16 instructions. It was started at the owner's request without the planned gate of one complete, error-free validation run
09e684c6275ce61b.caveat: Every result file is kept outside the repository because it holds each reply and response ID. The 2026-11-18 run saved its JSON but not its full printed score sheet, so the four replies were scored again offline with the repository's own scorers; the verdicts matched. The JSON does not record the definition hash: the runner printed it and refuses to run unless the published definition matches main's, and main at 18190c5 builds 09e684c6275ce61b. The four-ticket run's per-ticket trace was retrieved afterward, on 2026-11-18, by read-only Foundry retrieval of its saved response IDs (no model call): ~/fwagent-runs/2026-11-18-v17-RITM0011072-0075.trace.jsonl.
